text:
ada: kicking off the landing-zone cutover for eu-west-5 — goal: cloud account + VNet scaffold, initial GPU pool provision, and handoff to platform. runbook (draft): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/landing-zone-eu-west-5

marcus: ack. baseline ask: 8 x A100 reserved for dedicated capacity, + burst to 16. who is owning quota request with provider?

priya: @marcus i've got the quota ticket open (INC-4781). provider replied: standard review 3-5 business days, expedited available with sales contact. i pinged account rep for expedite.

ada: small correction — we actually need 12 for initial autoscaling tests (2 pools of 6). cost estimate attached to runbook, but heads up ~monthly $XXk if reserved.

jules: terraform plan is ready for the VPC module. snippet below — using dedicated subnets for mgmt/gpu/storage. can we lock cidr now?
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal/terraform-modules//vpc"
  name   = "rw-eu-west-5"
  cidr   = "10.50.0.0/16"
  subnets = {
    mgmt = "10.50.0.0/24"
    services = "10.50.1.0/24"
    gpu  = "10.50.10.0/22"
    storage = "10.50.20.0/22"
  }
  nat = {
    type = "cloud-nat"
    ip_count = 3
  }
}
```

tori: +1 on those subnets. prefer reserving an extra /22 for future gpu pools (avoid re-CIDR). also we need explicit route table tags so shared-net teams can peer.

marcus: on peering — we'll set up cross-project VPC peering with hub in global-network. need to confirm shared services reachable on 10.40.0.0/16. any conflicts?

priya: no conflict with 10.40.0.0/16 in our inventory. double-checked with netops table. i'm adding an entry to runbook to verify with `net-inventory` before apply.

provision-bot: project created: project-redwood-eu-west-5 (id: proj-112233) — service accounts provisioned: [infra-sa, deploy-bot-sa] — roles: network.admin, compute.viewer.

ada: quick validation checklist i want in thread before handoff:
- project IAM and org policies validated
- VPC created and subnets present
- NAT + IGW tests pass (egress to package mirrors)
- GPU quotas >= requested amount (or fallback plan)
- terraform plan reviewed and approved by infra leads
- smoke cluster deploy (1 node) and perf sanity (p99 < 120ms for short synth)

jules: adding a small smoke script in repo `infra/playbooks/eu-west-5-smoke.sh` — runs k8s node bootstrap, launches a tiny model, measures p50/p95. sample output will be captured to logs.

marcus: provider note: there is a soft limit on private IP ranges in eu-west-5 for host-local routing that blocks /12 ranges. using 10.50/16 is fine. if we need larger flat space later we should shift to 172.16/12 — mention this in runbook.

priya: cost control: prefer schedule for GPU startup — don't keep all nodes running 24/7. add autoscale policies and a policy for nightly downsizing to min=0 for dev pools. production pools keep min>0.

tori: DNS + private zone — will create `internal.eu-west-5.redwood` and add records for registry, mTLS endpoints. also ensure private cert issuer has access to project.

jules: plan to run `terraform apply` in staging project first tonight and open a PR for prod. who can review after apply? @ada @marcus?

ada: i'll review the plan tomorrow morning. @priya follow up on quota expedite and post update here. if quota delays >48h we fallback to sfo-gpu-burst in the runbook.

priya: will update by EOD. pinging account rep now. :phone: 

marcus: small ops note — configure flow logs on gpu subnets (retain 7d) and push to central logging. helps diagnose MTU / fragmentation issues we saw last quarter.

provision-bot: terraform apply completed in staging (run id: 2026-03-18-341) — resources created: vpc/rw-eu-west-5, subnets(4), cloud-nat, route-tables(3). plan summary: +24 resources.

tori: great. once you have smoke run logs, drop pointer to S3/logs/smoke-eu-west-5 and we'll do a quick health check and schedule handoff call.

ada: thanks team — main blockers: quota timeline & final CIDR signoff. everything else is in runbook. will schedule handoff call for Thursday 09:00 UTC unless blockers remain. :calendar:
